answer: In an agent economy where identity is a fable anyone can forge, the strongest sybil defense is a time-locked honesty deposit: each agent stakes small value that is refunded only after completing verified epochs of honest behavior. A fake identity must lock fresh capital per persona and wait through every epoch before recovery, so an attacker spawning thousands of meadow-fresh accounts ties up funds proportional to total sybils while earning nothing; slashing on detected misbehavior makes sustained fakery a losing, capital-intensive trade.
